sourceChange: After class rename, exactly one serialization line changed to wrap original metric json under summary and expose full thread stacks.
otherThreadPolicy: Every other named/unnamed thread, including GC and resource sampler, excluded from application denominator.
rawDiscoveryIntersectionRule: Count each stack once for each category; intersection explicit; union = raw + matching - intersection. Inclusive frames deduplicated within each stack.
allocationUnit: Sampled TLAB or outside-TLAB byte weights, not exact object counts or physical memory.
limitations: No independent JFR decoding rerun; source delta and serialized full stack identity/conservation independently audited.
Phase intervals already established by original analyzer; sample time cooccurrence is not causal attribution.
Small sample sizes and method tracing prevent a precise speedup or latency decomposition claim.
